title: Architecture
tagline: Palaces, temples, gardens and their builders from the Great Wall to the Pritzker Prize
hero_caption: Himeji Castle, Hyōgo Prefecture, Japan, built 1601–1609
intro: The architecture and gardens of China, Japan and Korea, from the tombs and walls of the first Chinese empires through Buddhist cave temples, timber halls, Zen gardens, castles and tea houses to the modern architects who have made East Asia a centre of world architecture. Many early builders are unknown, so their works are grouped under collective entries; timber buildings have often been rebuilt, and the dates given say so.
